headline: Apple Launches Touchscreen MacBook Pro Lineup Powered by M5 Chips
summary: Apple officially launched its first touchscreen MacBook Pro models featuring M5 Pro and M5 Max chips. The new lineup includes an Ultra Retina XDR display and offers up to 24 hours of battery life.
why: Apple is the world's largest consumer hardware company; upgrades to the Mac portfolio stimulate enterprise and premium consumer upgrade cycles.

impacts.name: Apple Inc.
impacts.why: Touchscreen hardware additions and upgraded silicon may boost high-margin personal computing sales.
